facts.fact_text: All three applicants participated in the demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013.
The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was intended to be peaceful.
The demonstration held by İctimai Palata on 12 October 2013 was conducted in a peaceful manner.
After the end of the demonstration of 12 October 2013, the applicants were arrested at the entrance to a nearby metro station called Inshaatchilar.
The circumstances of the applicants' arrests are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, judgment of 11 February 2016).
The circumstances of the applicants' custody are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (application nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, judgment of 11 February 2016).
